mapper.select: SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME(date) as statTime, IFNULL(ipIndicatorCount,0) as ipCount, IFNULL(domainIndicatorCount,0) as domainCount FROM ( SELECT statTime, SUM(case when type='IP' then 1 else 0 end) as ipIndicatorCount, SUM(case when type='Domain' then 1 else 0 end) as domainIndicatorCount FROM ( SELECT FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(created_time)/(#{params.step}*3600)) * (#{params.step}*3600) AS statTime,type FROM cn_intelligence_indicator WHERE tags = #{params.name} and created_time >= #{params.startTime} and created_time < #{params.endTime} ) cn_knowledge_table GROUP BY statTime ORDER BY statTime ) table1 RIGHT JOIN ( SELECT FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(@cdate := DATE_ADD(@cdate,INTERVAL - #{params.step} HOUR))/(#{params.step}*3600)) * (#{params.step}*3600) date FROM (SELECT @cdate :=DATE_ADD(#{params.endTime}, INTERVAL + #{params.step} HOUR) FROM cn_intelligence_indicator) t2 WHERE @cdate > #{params.startTime} ) table2 ON statTime = date ORDER BY date
